title: SA Supply Chain Operations Manager
description:
Lead the Supply Chain Center of Excellence (CoE) for South America, ensuring standardized, efficient and compliant processes across Direct and Indirect Purchasing, Business Office and Purchasing Systems. The role governs policies, processes and systems, secures audit and regulatory compliance, and provides performance visibility to management. A critical mandate is to lead, for South America, the business side of the I‑ERP program, driving the successful implementation and adoption of SAP S/4HANA and Ariba for Supply Chain and Purchasing, enabling data‑driven decisions and sustainable operational excellence.

Qualifications

Profile / Requirements

Education

  • University degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Information Systems or related field.
  • Post‑graduate degree or MBA is a plus.

Professional Experience

  • Solid experience in Supply Chain and/or Purchasing, preferably in a multinational and multi‑plant environment.
  • Proven track record in process governance, standardization and continuous improvement.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex cross‑functional projects; prior ERP implementation experience (ideally SAP S/4HANA and/or Ariba) is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with audits, compliance programs and policy/procedure management.

Technical and Functional Skills

  • Strong knowledge of Purchasing and Supply Chain processes (Direct and Indirect).
  • Good understanding of ERP systems; hands‑on familiarity with SAP and e‑Procurement solutions (e.g., Ariba) is highly valued.
  • Experience working with Agile methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban or SAFe) in project delivery, including backlog management, sprint or increment planning, and iterative delivery.
  • Competence in process mapping and documentation tools; experience with KPI design and performance dashboards (e.g., Excel, Power BI or similar).
  • Solid analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable insights.

Languages

  • Fluency in Portuguese and/or Spanish.

Fluency in English required for regional and global interaction.

Competencies and Behaviors

Aligned with Ford Behaviors – Focus, Excellence and Collaboration :

  • Focus
    • Sets clear priorities and focuses the organization on the highest‑value Supply Chain and I‑ERP outcomes for South America.
    • Translates strategy into an executable roadmap, ensuring resources and attention are directed to what matters most for customers and the business.
  • Excellence
    • Drives disciplined execution, process rigor and high standards in policies, audits, data quality and systems usage.
    • Uses data and structured problem‑solving to deliver continuous improvement in cost, quality, timing and compliance.
    • Champions best practices and lessons learned from audits and projects, embedding them into standard work.
  • Collaboration
    • Builds strong, trust‑based relationships across countries, plants and functions (Supply Chain, Purchasing, Finance, IT, global CoEs).
    • Facilitates cross‑functional alignment, resolves conflicts constructively and creates a “one team” mindset for I‑ERP and operational initiatives.
    • Communicates clearly and transparently, ensuring stakeholders are informed, engaged and heard.

Additional Behavioral Capabilities

  • Change Leadership: Guides teams through transformation, particularly digital and ERP changes, with strong emphasis on communication, training and user adoption.
  • Results Orientation: Delivers on commitments, manages priorities and deadlines, and ensures projects achieve expected outcomes in terms of cost, quality and timing.
  • Customer and Stakeholder Focus: Balances global standards with local needs; actively listens to internal customers and provides pragmatic, value‑adding solutions.
  • Integrity and Compliance Mindset: Acts as a role model for ethical behavior, policy adherence and audit readiness.

Key Interfaces

  • Regional Purchasing, Supply Chain and Logistics teams
  • Plant and Country management in South America
  • Finance, Controlling and Compliance functions
  • Global Supply Chain and Purchasing Centers of Excellence
  • Global I‑ERP (SAP S/4HANA & Ariba) program team and IT organization
  • External auditors, consultants and solution providers (as needed)

#LI-FordArgentina

#LI-FD1

Responsibilities

Main Activities / Key Responsibilities

  • Process Governance and Standardization
    • Lead the definition, mapping, documentation and continuous improvement of end‑to‑end Direct and Indirect Purchasing processes across South America.
    • Ensure alignment with global standards, internal controls, legal and compliance requirements, harmonizing practices across countries and plants.
    • Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for Supply Chain and Purchasing processes and drive corrective/improvement actions.
  • Policy, Procedure and Audit Management
    • Own and maintain regional Supply Chain and Purchasing policies, procedures, work instructions and standards, ensuring regular review and updates.
    • Plan, coordinate and support internal and external audits related to Purchasing (e.g., ISO9001, MCRP, SA DRIM, AFR campaigns, OIC Direct & Indirect Purchasing).
    • Lead the response to audit findings, define corrective actions, track implementation and embed lessons learned into processes and systems.
  • Business Office Leadership
    • Manage Business Office routines for South America Supply Chain, including governance calendars, meeting preparation and action follow‑up.
    • Consolidate and analyze performance data, preparing management reports, dashboards and executive presentations that provide clear visibility of results, risks and opportunities.
    • Support regional and global leadership in strategic planning, target setting and tracking of major initiatives.
  • Purchasing Systems Ownership
    • Act as regional business owner for Purchasing and Supply Chain systems and tools, in coordination with global process owners and IT.
    • Ensure robust system configuration, data quality, master data governance and proper access management.
    • Provide guidance and support to users, including issue resolution, enhancement requests and coordination of training needs.
  • I‑ERP (SAP S/4HANA & Ariba) Leadership – South America
    • Lead, from the business side, the South America implementation of SAP S/4HANA and Ariba for Supply Chain and Purchasing (I‑ERP).
    • Coordinate the collection and validation of business requirements, process design and solution blueprinting, ensuring fit‑for‑purpose and standardized processes.
    • Oversee integration testing, user acceptance testing, data migration preparation and validation, cut‑over planning and post‑go‑live stabilization.
    • Develop and execute change‑management, communication and training plans to drive strong user adoption and realize expected benefits.
    • Act as key interface between regional business teams and global program/IT, ensuring timely issue resolution and decision‑making.
  • Stakeholder Management and Continuous Improvement
    • Coordinate cross‑functional and cross‑country teams (Purchasing, Supply Chain, Finance, IT, Plants and Corporate functions) to ensure consistent deployment of processes and systems.
    • Identify optimization opportunities in cost, quality, lead time, compliance and data reliability; prioritize and lead or sponsor related improvement projects.
    • Promote a culture of process discipline, digitalization and continuous improvement across the South America Supply Chain organization.

Somos um dos maiores empregadores do país, com 76 mil colaboradores que trabalham diariamente para oferecer alimentos de qualidade a preços justos para comerciantes, transformadores e consumidores finais.
Com infraestrutura moderna, o Atacadão oferece uma vasta gama de produtos, incluindo cerca de 10 mil itens nas categorias de laticínios, hortifrúti, bebidas, doces e biscoitos, higiene pessoal, limpeza, bazar, produtos pet, automotivo, além de serviços como padaria, açougue e frios e fatiados.
Presença digital por meio do e-commerce, com canais de vendas online, parcerias com aplicativos de entrega e o aplicativo Meu Atacadão, que oferece ofertas exclusivas nas lojas físicas.
Nossos pilares de sustentabilidade incluem o combate à fome e às desigualdades, diversidade e inclusão, e proteção ao planeta e biodiversidade.

O Grupo Carrefour Brasil promove e incentiva a inclusão e diversidade! Candidaturas de mulheres, profissionais negros(as), LGBTI+ e pessoas com deficiência são altamente estimuladas.

title: Vice President of Sales - LATAM
description:
About GTT

GTT is a leading networking and security as a service provider for multinational organizations, simply and securely connecting people and machines to data and applications – anywhere in the world. We serve thousands of organizations, bringing together the right people, partners and technology to reduce the burden on IT teams and solve the most pressing networking and security challenges. Built on our top‑ranked global Tier 1 network, GTT Envision is a single global technology platform to connect, orchestrate, virtualize and automate enterprise networks, enabling customers with consumable solutions to achieve business missions and meet ongoing demand when, where and how needed. Our portfolio includes SASE, SD‑WAN, security, internet, voice and other connectivity options, complemented by a suite of professional services and exceptional sales and support teams in local markets around the globe. We partner with our customers to deliver Greater Technology Together.

Role Summary

The VP, Sales - LATAM drives strategic market expansion for GTT by developing and nurturing high‑value, long‑term relationships with key Carrier, Wholesale, and Strategic Alliance partners across the Latin American region. This role focuses on ecosystem development, identifying and securing new business models, and creating sustainable revenue channels through partnerships, rather than direct transactional sales. The Manager will be responsible for defining and executing the strategic plan to significantly increase GTT's market presence and network reach in LATAM.

Job Scope and Stakeholder Engagement

This role serves as a strategic bridge between GTT's offerings and the LATAM carrier market.

  • External Focus: Primary interaction is with executive and strategic planning teams at Target Carrier Partners, Global Data Center Providers, and potential Channel Partners to establish commercial, network, and technology alliances.
  • Internal Collaboration: Works closely with Product, Strategy, Finance, and Legal to define partnership terms and new commercial models. Acts as the voice of the LATAM market to inform Sales Engineering and Network Planning on necessary infrastructure investments.

Duties And Responsibilities

This role's success is measured by strategic outcomes and long‑term pipeline growth, not immediate sales quota achievement.

  • Market Strategy & Penetration: Develop and execute a comprehensive LATAM Carrier Business Development plan, identifying white‑space opportunities, competitive threats, and potential strategic partners to secure GTT's long‑term competitive advantage.
  • Partnership Identification and Structuring: Proactively identify, qualify, and negotiate strategic agreements with major LATAM carriers (e.g., IXPs, Mobile Operators, Regional Tier 1/2 Carriers) to expand GTT's network footprint and service portfolio in the region.
  • Ecosystem Development: Cultivate a robust network of strategic channel and alliance partners to drive scalable, indirect distribution of GTT services.
  • Long‑Term Pipeline Generation: Establish a pipeline focused on multi‑year revenue potential stemming from new partnerships, joint ventures, and wholesale capacity swaps, ensuring sustainable growth.
  • Cultural and Business Acumen: Leverage deep regional knowledge and fluency in local business practices to effectively structure and manage relationships across diverse LATAM territories.
  • Reporting: Track and report on market penetration, new partnership launches, pipeline value of strategic deals, and the successful commercialization of new routes/services.

Required Experience / Qualifications

  • 15+ years of experience in a Business Development, Partnership Management, or Strategic Alliance role within the global telecommunications / technology sector focusing on the LATAM carrier market.
  • Demonstrated Success in Ecosystem Building: A proven track record of successfully identifying, negotiating, and launching complex, non‑standard commercial agreements (e.g., wholesale capacity swaps, joint GTM strategies, network peering).
  • Deep Regional Carrier Knowledge: Thorough understanding of the competitive landscape, regulatory environment, key contacts, and market trends across major LATAM countries.
  • Strategic & Financial Acumen: Knowledge of business concepts and financial modeling needed to assess partnership viability, structure favorable deals, and articulate the long‑term return on investment (ROI).
  • Exceptional Communication & Negotiation: Superior ability to influence, communicate, and negotiate with executive‑level stakeholders both internally and with external carrier partners.
  • Bilingual Proficiency: Fluency in Spanish and English is essential. Portuguese is a significant advantage, to effectively navigate business and cultural nuances in the region.
  • Networking and Relationship Capital: Existing strong relationships and a robust network within the executive and planning ranks of LATAM carrier accounts.
  • Ambition and Strategic Thinking: A proactive mindset focused on identifying and securing next‑generation opportunities and expanding GTT's strategic positioning, not just fulfilling immediate demand.

Core Competencies

  • Business Acumen: Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business; ability to apply this knowledge appropriately to diverse situations.
  • Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
  • Negotiating: Knowledge of successful negotiation concepts and techniques; ability to negotiate successfully across the organization and with external vendors and clients in a constructive and collaborative manner.
  • Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem‑solving appropriately to diverse situations.
  • Networking: Understanding the business value of creating mutually beneficial relationships with individuals outside of incumbent's own organization and ability to generate productive relationships with internal and external partners that improve access to resources and expertise.
  • Channel Sales: Knowledge of various channel sales strategies and solutions used to execute and fulfil a sales plan; ability to sell a hospitality organization's brand, products, and services through multiple and diverse avenues
  • Sales Proposals and Presentations: Knowledge of sales processes, tools, and techniques; ability to prepare and present formal recommendations for how the organization can meet the customer's needs.
  • Value Selling: Knowledge of the principles and practices for selling products, technology and services; ability to provide overall product / service 'value' and to differentiate support offerings that address clearly understood customer needs.

Universal Competencies

  • Continuous Improvement: Knowledge of transformation initiatives to drive fundamental changes, enhance responsiveness and efficiency to core business practices. Ability to drive cultural changes from best effort to results oriented.
  • Customer First (Customer Facing): Knowledge of internal customer interactions, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, and partnership. Ability to build an environment supporting internal customer value creation at every level.
  • Operational Excellence: Understanding the system‑driven processes for consistency and scalability. Ability to re‑focus processes and systems from integration activity to maximizing a positive customer impact and anticipating future trends.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

  • Forte comprometimento com a segurança, incluindo o cumprimento dos protocolos de Saúde e Segurança da ERM estabelecidos.
  • Capacidade de ter sucesso em ritmo de consultoria, lidando com múltiplas atribuições de projetos e mantendo a flexibilidade, cumprindo prazos rigorosos.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens a negócios e carteira de habilitação válida.

A Environmental Resources Management (ERM) é uma fornecedora líder global de serviços de consultoria ambiental, de saúde, segurança, riscos e sociais, além de serviços relacionados à sustentabilidade. Possuímos mais de 160 escritórios em mais de 40 países e territórios, empregando mais de 5.500 pessoas que trabalham em projetos em todo o mundo. A ERM está comprometida em fornecer um serviço consistente, profissional e da mais alta qualidade para gerar valor para nossos clientes. Trabalhamos com muitas das empresas da Fortune 500 Global, fornecendo soluções inovadoras para empresas e clientes governamentais selecionados, ajudando-os a compreender e gerenciar os desafios de sustentabilidade que o mundo enfrenta cada vez mais.

Há mais de 50 anos, trabalhamos com clientes em todo o mundo e em diversos setores da indústria para ajudá-los a compreender e gerenciar seus impactos ambientais, de saúde, segurança, riscos e sociais. Os principais setores que atendemos incluem Petróleo e Gás, Mineração, Energia e Manufatura, Química e Farmacêutica. Todos enfrentam desafios críticos de sustentabilidade e nossos clientes nessas e em muitas outras áreas contam com nossa capacidade de ajudá-los a operar de forma mais sustentável, o que gera um impacto positivo em nosso planeta.

Na ERM, sabemos que criar um ambiente de trabalho diverso, equitativo e inclusivo é parte essencial para tornar nossa empresa um ótimo lugar para construir uma carreira.

Se você deseja ler mais sobre Diversidade, Equidade, Inclusão e Pertencimento (DEIB) na ERM, você pode visitar nosso site ou ler sobre nosso progresso no Relatório de Sustentabilidade de 2024.

  • Manter e atualizar a documentação de segurança crítica, como P&ID's (Diagramas de Tubulação e Instrumentação), manuais de operação e relatórios de análise de risco.

Informações adicionais


Contamos com um programa de benefícios flexíveis em que você poderá personalizar seus benefícios de acordo com seu momento e estilo de vida.



  • Assistência Médica;

Nossa declaração de Diversidade Equidade & Inclusão


Na JDE Peet's, nosso propósito é criar um futuro melhor, no qual servimos, refletimos e abraçamos todos em suas autenticidades. Acreditamos na promoção de uma organização mais diversa, equitativa e inclusiva, em que todos se sintam confortáveis para serem, verdadeiramente, quem são e possam despertar todo o seu potencial. Isto significa que não toleramos qualquer tipo de discriminação com base em raça ou etnia, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica diversa e protegida por lei.


Ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida dos associados, priorizamos DE&I no centro dos nossos processos de pessoas. Isso nos permite promover o respeito e eliminar qualquer preconceito ou ação discriminatória, garantindo uma experiência inclusiva no ambiente de trabalho. Não hesite em entrar em contato se precisar de qualquer suporte durante o processo de recrutamento.


#DesperteSuasPossibilidades #UmaXícaradeMomentosIncríveis


Descrição da empresa


Quem somos nós?


A JDE Peet’s é uma empresa líder mundial especializada em cafés e chás, sediada na Holanda e com uma história que começou em 1753. Despertamos possibilidades de café e chá em mais de 100 países com um portfólio de mais de 50 marcas.


No Brasil, somos uma das maiores empresas de café e temos atuação nacional com liderança absoluta em São Paulo e no Rio de Janeiro, através de nossas marcas Pilão, L’OR, Café do Ponto, Damasco, Café Maratá, Caboclo, Café Pelé, Café Puro, Chá Maratá e Chá Castelari.


Como é trabalhar na JDE Peet's?


Somos pessoas unidas pelas possibilidades de chá e café. Na JDE Peet's, nós nos desenvolvemos com a liberdade de buscar oportunidades e de provocar novas ideias para causar grande impacto.


Nossa ambição é simples: despertar possibilidades de café e chá.


Colocamos em prática nossas intenções, cumprindo o que foi acordado e sempre levando as coisas adiante. Oferecemos aos nossos associados uma série de programas de aprendizado e desenvolvimento para apoiar seu crescimento pessoal.


Na JDE Peet's, acreditamos que é incrível o que acontece ao redor uma xícara de café ou chá.


Inscreva-se para experimentar uma xícara de momentos incríveis para sua carreira.

title: Senior Azure DevOps Engineer
description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.


What we are looking for
  • 7+ years of experience in DevOps, with 5+ years in Azure environments
  • Expertise in Azure infrastructure, networking, and security, including VNets, Front Door, WAF, Firewalls (Premium + IDPS), VPN, DNS, AD, App Service, Container Apps, Function Apps, Event Hub, Defender, and Sentinel
  • Preferred experience administering Azure AD B2C, with deep understanding of identity and authentication security best practices
  • Strong experience with Terraform (IaC), managing scalable and resilient cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience managing CI/CD pipelines with Azure Pipelines, incorporating security and performance testing
  • Expertise in Application Performance Monitoring (APM) with Datadog strongly preferred, including real-time alerting and troubleshooting
  • Familiarity with Hub-and-Spoke network architecture and cloud security principles
  • Strong database administration experience with Azure SQL Server, including cloud-based backup, replication, and high-availability strategies. Experience with the Hyperscale service tier is a strong plus.
  • Experience with disaster recovery, incident management, and high-availability architectures
  • Deep understanding of DevSecOps principles, including security compliance, role-based access control, and vulnerability management
  • Proficiency in Git and GitHub for version control and workflow automation
  • Experience in optimizing cloud costs (FinOps) and monitoring usage trends.
  • Ability to thrive in a detail-oriented, fast-paced remote work environment, handling multiple projects simultaneously
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience supporting a remote team
  • Azure and/or Security certification(s) a plus
Responsibilities
  • Manage and optimize Azure infrastructure, networking, security, and identity management, ensuring compliance with SOC 2 and industry best practices
  • Ensure customer-facing systems maintain high availability and rapid incident response, including automated failover and disaster recovery strategies
  • Maintain and enhance Azure Pipelines for seamless CI/CD workflows, integrating automated security, unit, integration, and end-to-end testing
  • Implement and manage Terraform for infrastructure automation
  • Own the Datadog APM ecosystem, implementing best practices for monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and compliance
  • Implement DevSecOps practices, including security scanning, role-based access controls (RBAC), and proactive threat mitigation using Azure Defender and Sentinel
  • Continuously monitor Azure cost trends, implementing FinOps strategies to optimize cloud expenses while maintaining performance and security
  • Administer and enhance Azure AD B2C, ensuring secure authentication and identity management
  • Develop and maintain incident response playbooks and disaster recovery strategies, ensuring data integrity and business continuity
  • Work closely with Engineering and Security teams, documenting best practices, infrastructure changes, and operational procedures
Company Benefits
  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

title: Técnico Segurança do Trabalho
description:
Esta vaga não aceita mais candidaturas!

1 posição

Elaboração de material e aplicação de treinamentos relativos à área de segurança do trabalho;

  1. Realizar inspeções em equipamentos de combate a incêndio e atendimento a emergências;
  2. Inspeções na área operacional para garantir o atendimento aos procedimentos implementados e verificar condições de equipamentos;
  3. Avaliação de documentação, realização de integração e liberação da permissão de trabalhos especiais para prestadores de serviços;
  4. Gerenciar, digitalizar, arquivar e fazer análise crítica semanalmente da qualidade das Permissões de Trabalhos abertas e encerradas no período;
  5. Levantamento de informações e realização de relatório de investigação de acidentes;
  6. Realizar Diálogos de Segurança com foco prevencionista e/ou divulgar desvios de segurança do trabalho;
  7. Executar os processos de CIPA: Reunião mensal, processo eleitoral, plano de trabalho;
  8. Conduzir as reuniões mensais e coordenar a Brigada de Atendimento a Emergências;
  9. Prestar atendimento de 1° socorros aos colaboradores, prestadores de serviços e visitantes;
  10. Ministrar treinamentos específicos de Segurança do Trabalho (HSE): Segurança nas docas (TDR), Palete Duplado, uso de carrinho paleteira hidráulica, Trabalho em dupla (Team Lift), Segurança nos pátio (Yard Marshall), etc.;
  11. Planejar, agendar e gerenciar Auditorias de Segurança do trabalho para o time de Operações;
  12. Realizar Auditorias no processo Doca, Pátio e empilhadeiras PIT;
  13. Participar das reuniões diárias / start up meetings (SUM) e apresentar as informações de Segurança do Trabalho (EHS);
  14. Fazer análise crítica semanalmente da qualidade das não conformidades encontradas nas auditorias;
  15. Acompanhar diariamente os sistemas de Segurança do Trabalho para verificar ações vencidas e dar suporte sempre que necessário para os líderes e associados que tiverem dúvidas das ferramentas.

Localização

Estrada Campinas Pirajá, Campinas de Pirajá, Salvador - BA, Brasil,
